apilado-semiarco.descripcion: Capas de globos con helio a la misma altura, una encima de otra, con el remate arriba.
pasos: Nivel 1 (capa): 1 trío de R-12 rojo (1), R-12 dorado cromado (2).
Nivel 2 (capa): 1 trío de R-12 dorado cromado (2), R-12 rojo (1).
Remate: Globo Metalizado Corazon Dorado Mate 18" (3).
Ata cada globo a su cinta y todas las cintas a la pesa.
apilado-semiarco.prompt_gemini: BOUQUET ASSEMBLY — a helium balloon bouquet on ribbons tied to one weight, stacked in layers of balloons at the same height, one layer directly above the other. From the bottom up: level 1 (layer): 1 trio of red 12" latex balloons, high-shine chrome gold 12" latex balloons and red 12" latex balloons; level 2 (layer): 1 trio of high-shine chrome gold 12" latex balloons, red 12" latex balloons and high-shine chrome gold 12" latex balloons. Topper: matte gold foil heart. Keep each layer level and centered over the one below; the topper floats highest.
apilado-semiarco.prompt_lora: a helium balloon bouquet stacked in level layers of red and gold balloons topped by gold foil heart
